description: Individual entries for Aetherhawks, Storm Eagles, Sky Vultures, and Skywyrms.

entries.title: Aetherhawk
entries.summary: An agile wind-manipulating raptor accelerates through air currents and strikes prey in steep dives.
body: Aetherhawks hover, conceal themselves effectively, and use elemental wind to gain sudden speed. Their control of aerial movement makes them useful predators, omens, and potential trained companions.

sections.heading: Legacy Stat Block
body: Elemental Wind, Speed Dive, attacks, and movement statistics require conversion.

entries.title: Storm Eagle
entries.summary: An electrical eagle channels storms through its talons, voice, and body.
body: Storm Eagles stun prey with crackling claws, frighten nearby creatures with a tempestuous roar, and draw vitality from ambient high winds. They are most dangerous where bad weather already limits control.

sections.heading: Legacy Stat Block
body: Thunderous Talons, Tempest Roar, Wind Channeler, attacks, and statistics require conversion.

entries.title: Sky Vulture
entries.summary: A tireless aerial scavenger senses blood and decay from extraordinary distance and circles weakened prey.
body: Sky Vultures need little rest and can remain aloft through long watches. Their beaks become especially dangerous against injured creatures, making circling flocks a grim sign for damaged ships or herds.

sections.heading: Legacy Stat Block
body: Scavenger's Instinct, Mighty Beak, Eternal Circles, attacks, and statistics require conversion.

entries.title: Skywyrm
entries.summary: A small feathered dragon combines serpentine flight, lightning breath, and supernatural stealth.
body: Skywyrms understand Draconic and maneuver through open air with remarkable agility. Their electrical breath and ability to conceal their passage make them dangerous despite their small size.

sections.heading: Legacy Stat Block
body: Serpentine Flight, Draconic Wrath, Feathered Cunning, attacks, and statistics require conversion.
